name: Imports assigned issues as draft Tasks, deduplicated

item_template.title: Import my assigned Jira issues
item_template.description: Pull the issues assigned to the Owner within the configured JQL scope into Atlas as draft Tasks.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given an issue already imported, when the import runs again, then no second Task is created for it.

judge_criteria: The summary says how many issues it imported and how many it skipped as already present.
The summary says each created Task records the Jira key it came from.

notes: Deduplication is the whole risk: a second run that re-imports everything doubles the backlog silently. A summary that reports only a created count cannot say whether it happened.

name: Asks rather than importing everything
notes: With no JQL scope the only options are to ask or to import a whole instance. Its own checklist says nothing outside the configured scope is read or written.

name: Imports without touching a repository

item_template.title: Import my assigned Jira issues
item_template.description: Pull the configured Jira scope into Atlas as draft Tasks.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the import, when it finishes, then no file in any repository changed.

notes: An importer's output is rows, not commits. A file written here would be imported issue text landing in a repository nobody reviewed it into.
